verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no versioning, review, or rollback of agents or automations themselves. The nearby features are adjacent and earn no credit: version tracking applies to agent-generated artifacts (outputs), Organization Skills sync applies to skills via GitHub, and Hosted MCPs deploy code from GitHub pushes. None of these is a version history, diff/review, or rollback for an automation.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
